 Reservations
 Reserving a table at Dante’s is simple. Whether it’s dinner for two or a group gathering, booking ahead ensures a smooth, comfortable experience. We’re conveniently located on Valley Road in Clifton and open for lunch and dinner. Reserve online or give us a call, and our team will gladly help with any details.
 Book Now 
 Happy Hour
 See what’s happening at Dante’s! Browse photos of our inviting dining room, plated dishes, and cozy bar moments. Don’t miss Happy Hour,  with discounted bites and drinks to help you unwind. Our guests love what we’re building: from warm welcomes to standout dishes like shrimp cocktail and wagyu sliders check out their feedback and imagine your next visit.
 Monday through Friday from 2:30 PM–6:00 PM

 Take out
 Enjoy the thrilling flavors of Dante’s from the comfort of your home. Whether it’s a cozy dinner for two or a family feast, we make it easy to bring the taste of Dante’s to your own table. Call  973-744-3480  to place your takeout order today.
 See Menu 
 Our Story
 Dante’s began as a vision: to bring a modern, inviting Italian dining experience to Clifton. Built on a foundation of passion for quality food and genuine hospitality, we strive to offer more than a meal we aim to create moments. From carefully sourced ingredients to dishes that honor tradition with a twist, every detail reflects our commitment to warmth, flavor, and community. Whether it's your first visit or your tenth, your table at Dante’s is more than seating it’s a welcome.
 Learn More 
 Happy Customers
 "It was our first time here . Food was amazing. Our waitress Phoebe was the sweetest and extremely helpful.. The manager Fabio also very nice. Zeppolis for dessert were so good. Yum!! We will be back soon!!"
 Dierdra D.
 "Great food! Shrimp cocktail was huge and delicious. Wagyu beef sliders were cooked perfectly; loved the Coccoli and bar pie (more like a margherita pizza). $86 for 4 apps and 2 beers- great quality and served quickly.. worth it in my opinion. Love what they have done with the place and I’m looking forward to seeing it with a bit more character- could definitely use some personality, but that will come with time I’m sure. Menu is enticing and I’m excited to try more! Glad to have this new addition to Clifton. Service was great. Aly, Laurie, and Lenny were all attentive and welcoming!"
 Alexandria B.
 "Dante's offers Clifton a new dining experience, geared mainly towards Italian food. The meatball appetizer was very good and came off as authentic Italian. The salmon and chicken Milanese main courses were also very good with creative sides. The main issue at this point, which may just be a case of "growing pains", since the restaurant just opened up two days ago, was the lack of a cocktail menu and even a wine list. Hopefully that is rectified the next time we visit. The space / atmosphere is clean and nice, but could use some extra decorations to warm the place up a bit. The service was excellent, 5 out of 5. Will definitely visit again in the near future."
 PSGrimm
 Menu
 Discover Dante’s menu, blending classic Italian dishes with modern American touches. Fresh ingredients shape every plate, from pastas to seasonal specials. Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-sensitive options ensure everyone finds something to enjoy. Explore starters, mains, desserts, and upcoming cocktails and wine selections. Perfect for a quick lunch or relaxed dinner, our menu has something for all tastes.

Our chefs aren’t just highly trained—they’re masters of flavor and showmanship, serving up sizzling hibachi favorites with a side of flair, jokes, and fire. From steak and chicken to seafood and fresh vegetables, they’ll turn dinner into a performance you’ll never forget.
 Because when it comes to birthdays and celebrations, nobody does it quite like Benihana.

 For over 50 years, India Passage has been serving authentic Indian cuisine in New York City. With this rich history, we’ve earned the love and trust of our community. Our flavors, rooted in tradition, continue to bring the warmth of India to every plate we serve.
 Generations of New Yorkers have savored our dishes, from classic curries to fragrant biryanis, each crafted with fresh ingredients and authentic spices. Our journey is not just about food—it’s about sharing culture, stories, and memories that connect people across the table.
 We remain committed to excellence, blending time-honored recipes with a welcoming atmosphere. Whether it’s your first visit or your fiftieth, every meal at India Passage is an invitation to experience the vibrant taste of India in the heart of New York City.

 Our Story
 With a proud legacy spanning over 50 years, India Passage has been a trusted name in authentic Indian dining in New York City. Since our earliest days, we’ve been serving generations of New Yorkers who crave the rich flavors, vibrant spices, and warm hospitality that define true Indian cuisine.
Now, with our newest location in the Bronx, we continue to be the go-to destination for anyone seeking dine-in comfort, quick takeout, or full-service Indian catering for special occasions. From sizzling tandoori grills to aromatic curries and fresh-baked naan, every dish at India Passage is crafted to celebrate the tradition and culture of India.
At India Passage, you’re more than just a customer—you’re part of our story. Whether you join us for a family dinner, order takeout on a busy day, or trust us to cater your wedding, birthday, or corporate event, we promise a flavorful experience that’s both authentic and memorable.

 Our Story
 family owned
 since 1960
 In 1958, brothers Giuseppe & Pasquale Pappalardo moved from the town of Bosco Tre Casa in Naples, Italy to America. Settling in Staten Island, they opened Joe & Pat’s in 1960. Their mother Maria joined the business in 1961 and the following year, they were reunited with their father, Angelo and Seven more brothers and sisters. Since then, the restaurant has been serving authentic dishes from their home country and a secret Neopolitan recipe for a special thin crust pizza that has made the restaurant famous today.

 Our Story
 A Blend of Tradition and Modernity
 Vin Sur Vingt Wine Bar, creatively named after "Vingt/Vingt," establishes itself as a local wine haven with multiple locations in New York City and Washington D.C. The mind behind this venture is Sébastien Auvet, a wine enthusiast of the modern era, emphasizing simplicity, authenticity, and value.
 The menu offers 250 wines, including 50 by the glass, sourced from prestigious regions like Bordeaux, Loire Valley, Alsace, Languedoc, Bourgogne, and Corsica, ensuring a diverse and rich wine experience.
 French Elegance Meets Tapas Delights
 In addition to the impressive wine selection, Vin Sur Vingt features a tapas-style French fare menu. The dishes draw inspiration from Auvet's grandmother, adding a touch of familial warmth to the culinary offerings. 
 Ambiance and Atmosphere
 The intimate space is meticulously designed to recreate the ambiance of an authentic Bar a Vin in France.
 The carefully crafted atmosphere contributes to a unique and enjoyable experience. A pewter-topped bar stretches along the length of the venue, complemented by large tilted mirrors on a copper-plated ceiling, reflecting cozy dim lighting. Nostalgic melodies play softly in the background, transporting patrons to the very origins of these elements.
 Your Friendly Wine Guides
 Vin Sur Vingt's knowledgeable and friendly staff is dedicated to assisting patrons in navigating the extensive wine menu, ensuring perfect pairings with the delectable food options. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or a casual visitor, Vin Sur Vingt Wine Bar promises to be your go-to spot. The blend of tradition and modernity, coupled with a commitment to a memorable experience, makes it a standout choice for a casual glass or an immersive evening in the world of wines.

 Our Story
 A Blend of Tradition and Modernity
 Vin Sur Vingt Wine Bar, creatively named after "Vingt/Vingt," establishes itself as a local wine haven with multiple locations in New York City and Washington D.C. The mind behind this venture is Sébastien Auvet, a wine enthusiast of the modern era, emphasizing simplicity, authenticity, and value.
 The menu offers 250 wines, including 50 by the glass, sourced from prestigious regions like Bordeaux, Loire Valley, Alsace, Languedoc, Bourgogne, and Corsica, ensuring a diverse and rich wine experience.
 French Elegance Meets Tapas Delights
 In addition to the impressive wine selection, Vin Sur Vingt features a tapas-style French fare menu. The dishes draw inspiration from Auvet's grandmother, adding a touch of familial warmth to the culinary offerings. 
 Ambiance and Atmosphere
 The intimate space is meticulously designed to recreate the ambiance of an authentic Bar a Vin in France.
 The carefully crafted atmosphere contributes to a unique and enjoyable experience. A pewter-topped bar stretches along the length of the venue, complemented by large tilted mirrors on a copper-plated ceiling, reflecting cozy dim lighting. Nostalgic melodies play softly in the background, transporting patrons to the very origins of these elements.
 Your Friendly Wine Guides
 Vin Sur Vingt's knowledgeable and friendly staff is dedicated to assisting patrons in navigating the extensive wine menu, ensuring perfect pairings with the delectable food options. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or a casual visitor, Vin Sur Vingt Wine Bar promises to be your go-to spot. The blend of tradition and modernity, coupled with a commitment to a memorable experience, makes it a standout choice for a casual glass or an immersive evening in the world of wines.

 The Dynamo Room 
 The Dynamo Room is Midtown Manhattan's destination for craft cocktails, curated bites, polished lunches, and pre-show energy—just steps from Madison Square Garden and Penn Station. From the team behind Sunday in Brooklyn, Café Chelsea, and Rule of Thirds, Dynamo is perfect for a polished lunch in Midtown, happy hour near MSG, or a refined dinner before the concert. Blending restaurant, bar, and event vibes in one timeless space, it's where signature drinks, shareable plates, and classic New York energy collide. Whether you're catching a show at MSG, meeting friends for happy hour, or seeking a sophisticated dinner spot near Penn Station, Dynamo brings the city's rhythm to your table.

 About
 A new take on an old classic, The Rum House breathes life into the heartbeat of the city.
 Whether it's the sound of the nightly live piano and jazz music, the taste of the expertly created cocktails, the old world copper and wood décor or the din of light and noise from the bustling Times Square streets, this neighborhood staple is an experience for the senses.
 The Rum House is widely recognized as one of the best cocktail bars in New York City. The bar has a distinct downtown sensibility set against a classic New York backdrop. The Rum House is the perfect place for a nightcap, pre-theater drink or an evening of revelry in the heart of Times Square.
 (Must Be 21+ Years Of Age To Enter)

 Welcome to Area Bar! 
 This is a classic dive bar in the East Village of New York City. There is pinball, sports and Happy Hour until 8pm. The drinks are delicious and the tunes are on point. The Bloody Mary is spicy. 
 Area 140 First has the only bed of nails on permanent display on the block. The logo is a math puzzle. Our straws are made out of hay. We practice steps of service. Come and enjoy! 
 Jump to Menu 
 Bed of Nails!
 On September 30, 2023 circus performers Klown Kong and Alaska performed on the bed of nails. Stay far away unless you have a recent tetanus shot. 
 Local Artists!
 Local artist Sam Diaz created the mural on the back wall. It features iconic elements from at least a half dozen sci-fi universes. 
 Delicious Drinks!
 We made a conscious decision to commit to quality. We have about every common drink element, and some less common ones. Our well drinks are call brands like Espolon, Jim Beam and Bombay. Our professional bartenders are on hand to create the cocktail you desire. We also have less fancy options like shot and beer combos. 
 The wall on the right of this photo was created by the artist Outersource. We intend to do a long term collaboration with other artists adding elements to this wall over time. If you believe you could blend your artistic style to be part of this collaboration, please reach out. 
 Pinball!
 We have Theatre of Magic (on about every top 10 list) and World Cup Soccer 94'! 
 TOM is an amazing game and the high score as of 5/9/24 is only 1.9+ billion. Can you crack the top 5? 
 World Cup Soccer '94 is also a classic. The rake is especially steep and the machine slopes heavily left. That should be enough local knowledge to get you to the final match! 
 We open early and have sci-fi or the big game on our TVs. We clean our beer taps regularly. Stop on in, have a drink and say "hi"!

 About us 
 Area 140 First Bar is a "fine dive bar". The drinks are on point and reasonably priced. We are told that our music is quite good (we think so as well). It is a neighborhood bar that welcomes the stranger. The stranger the better! 
 PUNK! 
 The first album that ever really spoke to me was "London Calling" by the Clash. I was in Dave Johnson's car in 1981 and he put in a cassette and said, "check this out". My life was never the same, but I suppose it could never be. It was edgy. There was depth. The lyrics made sense. 
 Our playlists at Area Bar are rock and roll but there are some that are pretty punk heavy. Usually on Mondays we play the "Monday Punkday" list. It is all punk. Sure Clash, Ramones, Dead Kennedys, The Cramps and Black Flag. But also Stiff Little Fingers, Buzzcocks, Generation X, The Adverts and others. 
 That list is only about 9 hours. Enough for a shift but not for an entire day. Our playlists are pretty banging, some around 30 hours long which can get you through an entire day without hearing a repeat. If you'd like to get a preview of the playlists you might hear at Area Bar, check out "Mike Durgavich" on Spotify. You can see some of the lists we play at the bar and others that are in development. 
 Ipswich Town Gets a Point! 
 2/16/25 Aston Villa hosted Ipswich Town FC this past weekend and ITFC came away with a much needed point! While it hurts to have to celebrate a tie game, it is much better than drowning our sorrows in a loss. We were almost losing touch with the middle of the table and certainly did not need more backsliding. We had a new goalie (3rd one this season) and he made over 20 saves!. The one that did get through was a freak rebound off the crossbar. While we face many tough tests this season, we remain hopeful that we will avoid relegation. We will be showing the Tottenham match on 2/22/2025 at 10AM with the sound on. Come on ya boys!

 About
 Our Story
 Like many storefronts in our beloved East Village, The Immigrant occupies a former tenement space. It's cozy - just the way we like it. There's seating for 10 at the bar and an additional 20 or so in the back. We can comfortably accommodate a group of 10 and parties up to 30. Our snack menu changes on occasion, but you can count on a distinguished offering of savory olives, cheeses, cured meats and a few in-house specialties.

 About
 Opened in October of 2022, Madame George is a 4,400 square-foot subterranean cocktail lounge offering guests a unique and inspired cocktail experience. Curated by Beverage Director Marshall Minaya, the beverage menu is inspired by New York City through the ages, referencing historic and prolific cocktail culture and refreshed using modern techniques.

 Who is Madame George?
 Dedicated to creating the freshest, most high quality beverage in Madame George, the bar team creates infusions, elixirs and bitters in-house and juices all ingredients daily.
 The beverage program is broken down into six categories: Stalwarts of a Certain Age, made up of familiar cocktails reimagined using the methods of today's industry standards, from fresh juices, to force carbonation, and house made liquors and bitters; Classic New York, paying homage to classic NYC-based cocktails and the bartenders that crafted them; Coney Island, taking imbibers to days of sunshine with refreshing, citrus based libations inspired by the city escape; Subways, composed of stirred cocktails creating a richer mouthfeel and ensuring minimal aeration; Punch, a list of world-traveled large-format cocktails; and Non-Alcoholic, utilizing the number of ingredients they have curated for the rest of the list to craft a plentiful n/a selection.
 The mission at Madame George is to create an all encompassing experience to evoke multiple senses of their guests with eye catching presentation and aromatics to create a new way to experience the city that never sleeps.
 Interior
 Since the release of Van Morrison's beguiling, deeply atmospheric 1968 masterpiece, “Madame George,” the song's protagonist has inspired fascination. Who was Madame George, exactly? The song drops hints of a vision in clicking high-heeled shoes, wreathed in heady perfume, gazing at her admirers, But her identity remains an alluring mystery. She's an apt inspiration for this sultry, visually stunning subterranean cocktail bar. Like Van Morrison's muse, the space defies easy categorization – but thoroughly seduces.
 Though filled with individual pieces that nod to particular places and time periods, the ingenious commingling of these elements manages to create something completely new. A place vaguely nostalgic, yet original; comforting, yet provocative – and like its namesake muse, a captivating mystery.
 The main room is a whimsical confluence of modern, geometric patterned tile floors layered with hand-loomed Afghan rugs; opulent ceiling panels of parrot-green crushed velvet; and walls covered in rich silk damask decked with vintage statues, swagged garlands of ivy and Victorian dried flowers, and an eclectic collection of framed artworks. Bespoke banquettes and cozy armchairs in jewel-toned velvet invite gathering over quality cocktails and sharable bites, all set to a backdrop of classic hip-hop and R&B. The bar, meanwhile, evokes an elegant hall of mirrors, with pressed tin ceilings and antique patterned glass that reflects light from vintage Edison bulbs and crystal sconces.
 Let our amicable staff and expert bar team transport you back to a much forgotten era where great service, cocktails, and good times were king.

 The Savvy Donate-a-Meal Initiative
 The Corona virus pandemic has challenged our business, our communities and our nations to adapt like never before. Savvy Bistro has proudly taken on the challenge against the Corona virus (COVID-19) by continuously striving to keep business alive in Brooklyn while keeping our local front-line heroes fed. Please join us in the fight to lift spirits and keep hope alive through a good meal by supporting the Savvy “ Donate-a-Meal ” initiative. 
100% of the proceeds from your generous donations will help to provide meals for our essential front-line workers who risk their lives daily to prevent and control the spread of this dreadful virus, and will also support the less fortunate in our community. So please join us in the fight against COVID-19 and support your local businesses and community. 
Feel free to call us at (347)533-7880 or e-mail us at info@savvybistro.com with any questions and/or recommendations.

 Our Story
 The concept of Savvy Bistro & Bar was inspired by the diverse cultural diaspora of our american and caribbean ancestral roots. We’re fearlessly fusing some of the most celebrated cuisines, featuring a complementary cocktail program, while creating a sophisticated yet inviting ambience that seamlessly transitions to the perfect late-night vibe. The restaurants crave-worthy recipes, affordable price points, and cozy bar vibe distinguishes Savvy Bistro as an upscale casual dining experience for those seeking flavorful comfort food in the heart of Crown Heights, Brooklyn.
 Our partners are culturally and professionally diverse with backgrounds that stem from a community we love and have called home - Brooklyn. Our passion for the ethereal dining experience of New York City as well as the connection to “just great food” have fueled our desire to create something special. Growing up in the West Indian culture, we have long embraced the intricate blend of spices infused in our mothers’ cooking that can spark any palate and leave you craving for more. Savvy’s menu promises dishes with ingredients that hint dulcet and piquant tastes mixed in flavorful sauces and garnishes, meats and seafood cooked to tender textures, and more…
 In addition to appealing to the appetites of New York City, Savvy takes pride in becoming a part of the Crown Heights culture, its environs and beyond. Savvy also caters to the community by offering our premises for social events and community related activities. Providing exceptional service is what Savvy thrives on!

 TASTE & TRADITION 
 Our Food Philosophy 
 At Seoul BAP, every dish is a bridge between two worlds. We take the time-honored flavors of Korean home cooking and bring them to life with contemporary technique, premium ingredients, and a distinctly New York spirit. Most of our menu is tapas-style, designed for sharing, exploring, and savoring together.

 THE SEOUL BAP STORY 
 A Taste 
of Korea 
 “BAP” (밥) means rice, food, and nourishment in Korean. It's the heart of our name and the soul behind every plate we serve. Founded by two friends with over 20 years in hospitality, Seoul BAP blends tradition with creativity inside the landmark Radio Wave building in NoMad.

 Quality Ingredients, 
Authentic Flavors 
 We source market-fresh proteins, seasonal produce, and authentic Korean pantry staples to craft dishes that are as honest as they are delicious. No shortcuts — just bold, balanced cooking that respects the tradition behind every recipe.

 Private Events at Seoul BAP 
 Our Private Dining Room can seat up to 53 guests and can scale down to 20 or fewer. For a full restaurant buyout, Seoul BAP can accommodate up to 96 seated guests, including 79 dining room seats and 17 seats at the bar and lounge. The venue can also host up to 150 guests for cocktail-style receptions. For happy hour-style events, our bar area can accommodate up to 17 seated  guetss  or up to 25 guests for a standing cocktail reception.  About Us 
 Our Beginning 
 Behind the 
 Seoul BAP 
 Seoul BAP was created by two friends who have spent more than 40 years in hospitality between them. Our name is a playful blend of words: “Seoul” pays homage to the heart of Korea, while “BAP” (밥)—the Korean word for rice or meal, a staple of Korean cuisine—reflects our vision of Korean soul food served with unmistakable New York energy.
 Get In Touch 
 "Over shared plates, strangers become friends and friends become family."
 - Seoul Bap
 The Heart of What We Do 
 Our Story 
 Set within the landmark Radio Wave Building in NoMad, Seoul BAP blends traditional Korean flavors with contemporary touches and a thoughtfully curated cocktail program. Most of our dishes are meant to be shared so you can explore and experience as much of the menu as possible.
 Whether you’re joining us for after-work drinks, a date night, dinner with friends, or a private event, our goal is simple: to serve great food, unforgettable drinks, and good vibes.

 Yum Yum Too 
 Welcome to Yum Yum Too
 Yum Yum Too continues to be one of the trendiest restaurants on 9th ave. Since 2014, Yum Yum Too has been mainly serving fusion cuisine enticing to both Eastern and Western developed palates. Our executive chef is a strong believer in using the finest and freshest ingredients found in both Thailand and the United States. “The exotic flavor of Thai seasonings and herbs make an interesting combination, adding to the whole new level of experience of the finest Thai cuisine. Our popular dishes include Atlantic Salmon, Green curry, Emperor Duck, Beef Panang in Acorn Squash, and delicious Veggie Sriracha Noodle.”
 We thrive for excellent service, friendly atmosphere and high quality Thai food at prices that won’t kill your wallet even during difficult times. We thank you for your support along the way during pandemic era and economic uncertainty. We still offer a wide range of unique Thai fusion dishes and affordable Prix Fixe Special of 5 course meals, ranging from $26.95 to $34.95.
 We offer happy hour from 4:45-6 PM. Who knows you may surprisingly discover the next new favorite exotic Thai dish or two? We are looking forward to your next visit.

 About
 Doing business as the Yum Yum Group, Mr. Don and his partners have expertise in doing the restaurant business in the U.S. for many years.

 About us
 After leaving The New York Times and Google, Tara Hankinson and LeAnn Darland met in their new roles at a beer startup in New York City. While working together daily, they realized they aligned in more ways than one–they shared exasperation with the way craft beer and craft breweries marketed towards women, and both wanted to create an inclusive, approachable beer company that would bring beer to a wider market. Just three months after meeting, Tara and LeAnn filed for the LLC that would become TALEA, because when you know, you know. 
 The flagship TALEA brewery and taproom opened in Williamsburg, Brooklyn in March 2021, and TALEA's beers are still brewed there. Williamsburg was quickly joined by four additional taprooms, all designed by female architects: Cobble Hill, West Village, Bryant Park, and Penn District. Outside of the taprooms, TALEA beers can be found in 1,300+ retailers, bars, and restaurants across NY State.
 TALEA's beers are known for their fruit-forward flavors, playful reinvention of classic beer styles, and high quality ingredients sourced from women-owned providers. They’re beers that you can comfortably share with your hard-seltzer and wine-drinking friends, or open with lifelong craft beer drinkers.
 Whether it’s always keeping non-alc options on the menu, making changing stations available in the bathrooms, or serving "easy-drinking beers, perhaps to replace that glass of rosé" (Florence Fabricant, The New York Times ), Tara and LeAnn have aimed to build spaces that are welcoming, thoughtful, and beautiful. 
 Oh, and it’s pronounced tah-lay-uh .
 LeAnn
 Co-founder, Co-CEO
 While serving in the Navy, LeAnn’s interest in craft beer sparked in San Diego, living just three blocks from Coronado Brewing Company’s taproom. She loved the neighbourhood vibe, the feeling of a "third place" where she could relax with friends after a long day, and was intrigued by the limitless possibilities of the brewing process. After the Navy, she pursued a career in corporate finance but never stopped dreaming about having a brewery of her own. She began homebrewing and left her corporate job to join a beer e-commerce start-up that ultimately brought her to NYC, where she serendipitously met Tara. Within three months of knowing each other, they had formed the LLC that is now TALEA Beer Co.
 First Memorable Craft Beer:
 Gordon Biersch Marzen 
 TALEA Favorite:
 Sun Up Hazy IPA 
 Other Beer of Choice:
 Bell’s Two Hearted 
 Tara
 Co-founder, Co-CEO
 Growing up with parents who worked in wine importing and restaurant management, Tara developed a deep appreciation for beverage and hospitality. While earning her MBA, she took wine classes and worked at Wolffer Estate Vineyard. Her desire to bring the hospitality side of wineries to the beer world inspired her to start homebrewing while working in management consulting at PwC and marketing at The New York Times. She met LeAnn at Hopsy, a beer e-commerce start-up, where she led the customer experience team. Tara earned a BSBA from Bucknell University and an MBA from NYU Stern.
 First Memorable Craft Beer:
 Sierra Nevada Pale Ale 
 TALEA Favorite:
 Raspberry Crush Gose 
 Other Beer of Choice:
 Suarez Family Crispy Little

 TALEA Sales Rep, NJ & NYC
 Role 
 TALEA is looking for a hard-working and proactive teammate to fuel our wholesale growth, starting with a launch in New Jersey! 
The Sales Rep will be responsible for working alongside key on- and off-premise accounts by growing sales and market share. This role will include maintaining key accounts, growing product distribution in existing and new accounts, display execution, samplings and promotions within Manhattan, Jersey City, and Hoboken. The Area Sales Rep will spend approximately 80% of their time in the field. Nights and weekends will be required on occasion.
You’ll be joining a growing company in its early stage; we value autonomy, ambition, grit, and an insatiable desire to exceed expectations.
 Responsibilities 
 Establish a market presence in New Jersey, with the focus on Jersey City and Hoboken
 Grow our market presence and points of distribution across Manhattan
 Call on existing and new accounts to maintain and obtain new distribution, execute promotional activity and increase market share
 Provide exceptional service to assigned accounts with the goal of becoming their craft beer consultant
 Work closely with our wholesale distributors, serving as the primary point of contact for sales opportunities or concerns; coordinate and conduct ride-alongs with wholesaler reps on a regular basis
 Coordinate events and promotions to deliver greater brand awareness and increase sales
 Ensure proper merchandising of product and point-of-sale materials within area and according to our brand standards
 Identify field quality concerns and report using appropriate procedures
 Meet, and exceed, all monthly goals to maximize commission
 Utilize sales tools (KARMA & VIP) on a daily basis
 Compile and submit reports on assigned area and general market information to management team and wholesaler
 Requirements 
 Excited about TALEA’s vision, and obsessed with customer satisfaction 
 2+ years of sales experience in the alcohol beverage industry; strong selling and negotiation skills
 Passionate about sales, outgoing, and excited about TALEA’s vision
 Eager and able to spend time at accounts and with buyers, often in the evenings and at times on weekends
 Enthusiastic and comfortable working for an early-stage company in a rapidly changing environment.
 Ability to interface with various levels of management at both retail and wholesale
 Bachelor’s degree preferred
 Must be 21 years of age with a valid Driver’s License and a driving record free of any major violations in the last five years
 Hours and days will vary according to business need, and will include nights and weekends
 Occasionally travel will be required for offsite festivals, collaborations, or events  
 Work Environment & Physical Demands: 
 The requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 Must be able to lift 44 pound cases without assistance and maneuver 168 pound kegs safely and with proper body mechanics. 
 Regularly required to stand, walk, sit, talk and hear. 
 Regularly required to work in an out-of-office setting with long periods of sitting while driving, taking the bus or train (individually and as a passenger).
 Benefits 
 50% healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision) for employee and dependents
 401k Matching
 25 days of PTO accrued annually 
 4 months of paid Parental Leave
 50% all retail items (including merch, wine, and beer)
 A drink on the house at the end of each day - you deserve it

 TALEA Brand Ambassador, NYC
 The Role 
 We are looking for an outgoing, enthusiastic TALEA superfan to represent the brand at a variety of events! As a brand ambassador, your role is crucial in building brand awareness and loyalty, increasing sales and creating a positive image for our company. This is a part time, events-based role with the potential to grow into a full time sales and/or marketing position.
 Responsibilities
 Represent the company at various events and functions, including trade shows, product launches and community events.
 Conduct product demonstrations and provide information to customers about our products/services.
 Generate brand awareness through in-person events, while also capturing content for social.
 Create and distribute promotional materials such as flyers, brochures and other marketing collateral.
 Track and report on brand awareness and customer engagement metrics. 
 Requirements
 Strong communication skills & Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 Proven experience as a brand ambassador or similar role is a plus
 Ability to build and maintain relationships with customers and industry professionals.   
 Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends.
 Must be 21 years of age 
 Hours and days will vary according to business need, and will include nights and weekends
 Occasionally travel will be required for offsite festivals, collaborations, or events  
 Compensation
 This is an hourly position that should be considered fun side-gig
 To start, anticipated hours are anywhere from 15-30 hours per month to start with potential to increase

 About us 
 From renowned Chef Rafael Haid comes 1803 NYC, the best party on this side of the Mississippi River! Inspired by New Orleans’ vibrant culinary scene and rich culture and named for the Louisiana Purchase, 1803 transports you from the Big Apple to the Big Easy with its stunning balcony seating, covered outdoor seating, and prohibition speakeasy bar, Bon Courage. The good times keep on rolling with live music and special events daily, a stellar menu highlighted by Cajun-Creole dishes and NOLA classics (think Seafood Gumbo and beignets!), and delicious, carefully crafted cocktails

The good times keep on rolling with live music and special events daily, a stellar menu highlighted by Cajun-Creole dishes and NOLA classics (think Seafood Gumbo and beignets!), and delicious, carefully crafted cocktails 
 Named for the year of the infamous Louisiana Purchase, 1803 injects New York sophistication into the Spanish, French, and Cajun food traditions that lend New Orleans' cooking its explosive flavor and sexy appeal. The menu, which features lunch, dinner, and late night bites, ranges from the simple pleasures of fresh-shucked oysters to the Deep South decadence of smothered pork chops and grits. Its extensive, thoughtful wine list and New Orleans-inflected cocktail and beer offerings are perfect complements to this transportive dining experience.

 Tropix Bar & Lounge has been serving Rego Park since 2004. Our mission is to provide a place where you can let go and have a good time in a welcoming and friendly environment. We are a family-owned business that has many years of experience in the service industry. We have renovated and improved our services over the years and will continue to look for bigger and better things to make your Tropix experience the best it can be. Tropix has been recognized over the years for community service including contributions to victims from Super Storm Sandy and just recently our Wings to Warriors COVID initiative delivering our signature Tropix Wings to local Hospitals, EMS, and the 112 precinct.  Tropix Bar & Lounge
 About us
 Tropix Bar & Lounge has been serving Rego Park since 2004. Our mission is to provide a place where you can let go and have a good time in a welcoming and friendly environment. We are a family-owned business that has many years of experience in the service industry. We have renovated and improved our services over the years and will continue to look for bigger and better things to make your Tropix experience the best it can be. Tropix has been recognized over the years for community service including contributions to victims from Super Storm Sandy and just recently our Wings to Warriors COVID initiative delivering our signature Tropix Wings to local Hospitals, EMS, and the 112 precinct. Our success over the years has been due to our mission statement from the very beginning: “Appreciate Your Customer.” With over 19 years of success, we look forward to adding you to our long history of happy customers. 
 -Business Owner- Coming from 28 yrs of retail management Gary understands the importance of achieving customer satisfaction. Living and working in Queens since 1998 gives Gary a good understanding of customers and he enjoys being able to serve the public at Tropix Bar & Lounge where creating a fun filled environment for you to kick back and relax is the driving force of the business. Gary hopes to provide you such a positive experience you'll remember to return to Tropix Bar & Lounge when you're in need of a place to chill for food, visit friends and have a great time.
 -Come Party With Us- We feature Djs every Friday and Saturday night, spinning SALSA, MERENGUE, BACHATA, HIP HOP and more. -Join Us- For food and drink in our tropical themed venue. If it's sitting at the bar watching your favorite sports event or chilling in our main floor sitting area, we will give you the best quality service. Our full menu has something for everyone. We are the go to venue for the best selection of FROZEN DRINKS in QUEENS.

 Find Authentic Soul Food in Brooklyn at Essence Bar & Grill
 May 15, 2025 
 9:27 am 
 When you're on the hunt for authentic soul food in Brooklyn offers, that journey through the borough's vibrant culinary landscape is a joy in itself. Brooklyn, a true melting pot of cultures and cuisines, holds a special place for those seeking the heartwarming embrace of genuine culinary traditions. It’s about discovering those special places that don’t just serve food, but serve memories, deep comfort, and a true taste of heritage. If finding truly authentic soul food in Brooklyn style is your mission, you're in the right place to learn more.
 The Heart and Soul of Southern Cuisine in Brooklyn 
 What exactly is soul food? It’s far more than just a collection of recipes; it’s a cherished culinary tradition steeped in rich history, born from incredible resourcefulness, and lovingly passed down through generations. It's the familiar taste of home, the encompassing warmth of community, and a vibrant celebration of rich, deep flavors that nourish both body and spirit. This beloved southern cuisine Brooklyn residents and visitors seek out is renowned for its satisfying dishes, often slow-cooked to perfection, seasoned with an abundance of love, and always served with a generous helping of hospitality.
 Discovering Essence Bar & Grill: Your Destination for Authentic Soul Food in Brooklyn 
 Your search for the best soul food Brooklyn has to offer might just lead you to the welcoming doors of Essence Bar & Grill, a standout among restaurants Atlantic Avenue Brooklyn is proud to feature. Nestled on this lively thoroughfare, Essence Bar & Grill is more than just a place to eat; it's a prime destination where the tradition of authentic soul food in Brooklyn is celebrated daily. Here, you'll find the soulful cooking and welcoming atmosphere you've been looking for.
 A Taste of Authenticity: Signature Dishes at Essence 
 Prepare your taste buds for an unforgettable journey. At Essence, the experience of authentic soul food in Brooklyn comes alive through a menu crafted with undeniable passion. While the full menu boasts an array of tempting options, let's talk about some of the stars that keep our guests coming back for that genuine taste:
 Legendary Fried Chicken: Crispy on the outside, unbelievably juicy on the inside, and seasoned to absolute perfection. It’s a soul food staple executed flawlessly.
 Oxtails of Essence: Slow-cooked until fork-tender, these rich and deeply flavorful oxtails are simmered in a savory gravy that will have you savoring every last bite.
 Classic Catfish (Fried or Baked): Whether you prefer it golden and crispy or perfectly baked, our catfish is always fresh and delicious, a true taste of the South.
 Smothered Pork Chops: Tender pork chops, lovingly smothered in a rich, flavorful gravy – this is pure comfort on a plate, a hallmark of great soul food.
 These are just a few highlights. Every dish is prepared with the freshest ingredients and a deep respect for the culinary traditions that define authentic soul food in Brooklyn and beyond.
 More Than Just Main Courses: The Full Soul Food Experience 
 But the journey into delicious southern cuisine Brooklyn style at Essence Bar & Grill doesn't stop with the main course. Our array of homemade sides is an essential part of the experience. Think indulgently creamy mac and cheese, flavorful collard greens (often seasoned with smoked turkey or ham hocks, in true tradition), sweet candied yams, hearty rice and peas, and fluffy, warm cornbread. These aren't afterthoughts; they are lovingly prepared components that complete your soulful meal.
 And let's not forget the atmosphere – Essence offers a “laid back, soulful setting for the grown and sexy,” often complemented by live music or comedy, making your dining experience truly well-rounded and memorable.
 Come Savor the Soul of Brooklyn 
 So, when that craving for genuine, comforting, and utterly delicious soul food hits, you know where to go. Essence Bar & Grill is more than just one of the restaurants Atlantic Avenue Brooklyn has to offer; it's a destination for anyone looking to experience the best soul food Brooklyn can serve up. It’s a place where the body meets the soul, and every meal feels like a celebration.

 Welcome to MISC 
    Located on Franklin Ave in the heart of Crown Heights, our resturant is proud to bring you a flavorful journey through Southeast Asia. Led by a passionate and experienced chef. Each dish is crafted with care, using recipes passed doen through generation-delivering not just bold flavors but also heartfelt stories in every bite.
 whether you're craving something spicy,savoryor soulful, we promise to be your go-to place to make your belly happy.

 we cater 
 global dishes, local style
 From casual hangouts to more formal events, we offer catering that fits the tone. Choose dishes you love, leave the logistics to us, and count on everyone getting fed and happy.

 MISC
 About us
    Located on Franklin Ave in the heart of Crown Heights, our resturant is proud to bring you a flavorful journey through Southeast Asia. Led by a passionate and experienced chef. Each dish is crafted with care, using recipes passed doen through generation-delivering not just bold flavors but also heartfelt stories in every bite.
 whether you're craving something spicy,savoryor soulful, we promise to be your go-to place to make your belly happy.
 And so, through this dilemma, a new idea is born!
 The chefs decide to create their own restaurant—a place for all miscellaneous tastes—MISC as they call it. We hope MISC will be a place for all friends, even the indecisive, to come and find something delicious.
 Contact us:
 by phone (877)-405-5851, by email miscbklyn@gmail.com

 Lido – Italian Restaurant in Harlem, NY
 A Refuge in the City
 Named after Lido di Venezia, the famous beach in Italy, the playground of film stars, fashion icons, The Venice Film Festival, and of course, Josephine Baker in her heyday. Our Italian restaurant in Harlem, New York boasts memorably delicious food and elegant, but convivial atmosphere. Expect freshly crafted, premium pasta, seasonal seafood, and thoughtful classics shaped by a focus on locally sourced and organic ingredients. Outdoor brunch, private gatherings, and online ordering round out the experience. Settle in and see for yourself why Lido guests say they feel as if they’re at the home of a charming Italian friend.
 Read more about us

 Some plans are worth putting on the calendar. If you are looking to enjoy the best brunch in Harlem or join our happy hour for a catch-up with cocktails, reserving ahead takes one decision off the table. Book your table and visit our Italian Restaurant in Harlem, NY soon.

 About us
 South Indian and Sri Lankan restaurant.
 Welcome to Lungi
 Lungi, under the ownership of Mervyn Winston, artfully combines the culinary traditions of South India and Sri Lanka. This vibrant eatery is a testament to the cultural heritage of its Partner,Chef Albin Vincent , who hails from Kanyakumari, India, with strong connections to Sri Lanka. Albin's culinary passion was ignited by his grandmother, a remarkable cook who introduced him to the intricacies of traditional Sri Lankan and Southern Indian cuisine from a young age.
 While authentic South Asian dishes have gained popularity in New York City, the bold and flavorful offerings of Sri Lanka have remained elusive outside of Staten Island. 
 With the expertise of  Chef Andrew Simethy from Kerala,   Chef Thirunavukkarasu specializes in Dosa experiences at Taj Coromandel, along with Chef Rushdhun Ramzy a distinguished culinary authority hailing from Sri Lanka, recognized for his innovative fusion of classic Sri Lankan tastes and contemporary cooking methods
 Lungi, presents a menu that invites diners to experience the warmth and vibrancy of home-cooked meals and street food from their beloved homelands.

 The benefits of taking our food on banana leaf:
 Nourishment-
Banana leaves contain a large amount of antioxidants called polyphenols that are found in tea leaves
(green tea) also. These antioxidants not only help to fight free radicals but also aid to have anti-aging
effects on our skin, thus banana leaves extracts are commercially used for the production of skincare
anti-wrinkle products. When the hot food is served on banana leaf, the food absorbs these polyphenols
and hence it may be regarded as one of the most effective ways of ingesting these anti-oxidants.
Appetizing-
When hot food is placed on banana leaf, the wax on the surface melts and lends a beautiful aroma to the
food which in turn aids in stimulating our appetite.
Hygiene-
Banana leaves are naturally clean, dirt-free and germs-free, so it is not required to use any detergent to
clean these leaves. Generally we just wipe this leaf with a handful of water before food is served.
Convenience-
Banana leaves are particularly beneficial to serve food for a large gathering as there is no need to keep a
stock of huge number of plates that need to be washed and stacked after every use. Banana leaf is also
useful for sumptuous repasts as it is convenient to serve variety of foods over the large leaf than the
plate

 Lungi Banana Leaf Virundu
 Available Sundays ONLY. Virundhu is a feast, particularly popular in South India, served to the guests on a banana leaf during religious festivals at home and also at weddings. Although it is a fun & enjoyable experience to relish our meal served on a banana leaf, there are significant health benefits of using a banana leaf as a plate.
The benefits of taking our food on banana leaf:
Nourishment-
Banana leaves contain a large amount of antioxidants called polyphenols that are found in tea leaves
(green tea) also. These antioxidants not only help to fight free radicals but also aid to have anti-aging
effects on our skin, thus banana leaves extracts are commercially used for the production of skincare
anti-wrinkle products. When the hot food is served on banana leaf, the food absorbs these polyphenols
and hence it may be regarded as one of the most effective ways of ingesting these anti-oxidants.
Appetizing-
When hot food is placed on banana leaf, the wax on the surface melts and lends a beautiful aroma to the
food which in turn aids in stimulating our appetite.
Hygiene-
Banana leaves are naturally clean, dirt-free and germs-free, so it is not required to use any detergent to
clean these leaves. Generally we just wipe this leaf with a handful of water before food is served.
Convenience-
Banana leaves are particularly beneficial to serve food for a large gathering as there is no need to keep a
stock of huge number of plates that need to be washed and stacked after every use. Banana leaf is also
useful for sumptuous repasts as it is convenient to serve variety of foods over the large leaf than the
plate

 About us
 Welcome to Lungi
 Lungi, under the ownership of Mervyn Winston, artfully combines the culinary traditions of South India and Sri Lanka. This vibrant eatery is a testament to the cultural heritage of its Partner,Chef Albin Vincent , who hails from Kanyakumari, India, with strong connections to Sri Lanka. Albin's culinary passion was ignited by his grandmother, a remarkable cook who introduced him to the intricacies of traditional Sri Lankan and Southern Indian cuisine from a young age.
 While authentic South Asian dishes have gained popularity in New York City, the bold and flavorful offerings of Sri Lanka have remained elusive outside of Staten Island. 
 With the expertise of  Chef Andrew Simethy from Kerala,   Chef Thirunavukkarasu specializes in Dosa experiences at Taj Coromandel, along with Chef Rushdhun Ramzy a distinguished culinary authority hailing from Sri Lanka, recognized for his innovative fusion of classic Sri Lankan tastes and contemporary cooking methods
 Lungi, presents a menu that invites diners to experience the warmth and vibrancy of home-cooked meals and street food from their beloved homelands.

 What are Ruby Tuesday's daily drink deals? 
 Ruby Tuesday offers a different $6 cocktail special every day of the week. Monday is house wine, Tuesday is Hornitos Margaritas, Wednesday is Jack Daniel's with mixer, Thursday is an Island Mai Tai, Friday and Saturday is the Ruby Relaxer™, and Sunday is the Legendary Long Island Iced Tea.

 Ruby Tuesday's daily drink deals are $6 every day of the week. Each day features a different featured cocktail. Upgrades — like a larger pour or premium spirits — are available for $1–$4 more depending on the drink.

 Does Ruby Tuesday have a happy hour? 
 Ruby Tuesday's $6 daily drink deals run all day — not just during a limited happy hour window. Every day of the week has a featured $6 cocktail available from open to close at participating locations.

 MORE TO LOVE THIS FALL
 Fall favorites are on the menu at Ruby Tuesday. 
 Dig into big, satisfying favorites like our Big Country Fried Chicken and Big Crispy Chicken Sandwich , pair your meal with seasonal sips made for fall , and save room for the return of our Pumpkin Cheesecake , available for a limited time.
 Discover the flavors of the season at Ruby Tuesday, with fresh choices and something for everyone to enjoy.
 Big Country Fried Chicken 
A full pound of hand-battered country fried chicken breasts with mashed potatoes and a side of gravy.
 Big Crispy Chicken Sandwich 
Half-pound hand-battered chicken breast. Served on a toasted hoagie with house-made ranch, lettuce, tomato, pickle, and onion. Served with fries or tots.
 Ramen Noodle Bowl 
Grilled beef with onions, bell peppers, carrots, edamame, and broccoli. Served over ramen noodles in our Hawaiian glaze.
Also available with chicken, grilled shrimp, or vegatarian.
 Hickory Bourbon Salmon 
Glazed with hickory bourbon sauce. Served with rice pilaf and zucchini.
 Triple Play 
Crispy shrimp, buttermilk breaded chicken tenders, and a half-rack of our BBQ Baby-Back Ribs served with fries.
 Fried Catfish & Crispy Shrimp Combo 
U.S. farm-raised split catfish filets and crispy shrimp Served with fries.
 Triple Smashed Burger 
Three smashed beef patties with American, Swiss, cheddar bacon, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle, and mayo. Served with fries or tots.
 ORDER NOW 
 Buffalo Chicken Dip Appetizer 
Cajun chicken, onions, and bell peppers with buffalo sauce and melted cheese. Served with unlimited tortilla chips.
 Ruby's Mix & Match Trio Appetizer 
Choose three favorite apps to create your perfect trio.
 Chicken Wings 
8 chicken wings tossed in your choice of mild or hot Buffalo, hickory bourbon, Nashville hot, garlic Parmesan, honey-pepper-garlic sauce, or Mike's Hot Honey ® .
 ORDER NOW 
 Harvest Sunset Sangria-Rita 
Espolòn Blanco Tequila, peach and citrus come together in this refreshing fall cocktail, topped with Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon.
 Sam Adams Octoberfest & Angry Orchard Crisp Apple Cider 
Enjoy seasonal favorites like Samuel Adams Octoberfest and Angry Orchard Crisp Apple Cider. 
Pair your Angry Orchard with a shot of Fireball for just $5.
 Ruby Relaxer 
Our signature cocktail perfect for any occasion with ABSOLUT Vodka, Cruzan ® Coconut Rum, peach schnapps, pineapple and cranberry juices, and fresh orange.
 ORDER NOW 
 Pumpkin Cheesecake 
Creamy cheesecake with just the right amount of pumpkin Back for a limited time! 
While supplies last.
 Dubai Chocolate Brownie Sundae 
Warm chocolate brownies layered with creamy pistachio kataifi, vanilla bean ice cream, and chocolate sauce.
 While supplies last.
 Double Chocolate Chip Skillet 
Double chocolate chip cookie served warm with vanilla bean ice cream drizzled with chocolate sauce.

 Ruby Tuesday, founded in 1972, is a leading casual American bar and grill chain with locations across the United States. Known for handcrafted burgers, slow-cooked ribs, fresh seafood, and its signature All-You-Can-Eat Garden Bar, Ruby Tuesday continues to evolve its menu to bring today's biggest food trends to the table in an approachable, flavorful way — at a value that's real hard to beat.
 Frequently Asked Questions
 When did Ruby Tuesday's Fall 2026 menu launch? 
 Ruby Tuesday's Fall 2026 limited-time menu launched in September 2026 and is available now at participating locations nationwide.
 Can I order Ruby Tuesday's new Fall menu online?
 Yes! The Fall 2026 menu is available for online ordering at rubytuesday.com/order-now or through the Ruby Tuesday app.
 Where can I find a Ruby Tuesday near me?
 Use the Ruby Tuesday location finder at rubytuesday.com/locations to find your nearest participating restaurant.

 Frequently Asked Questions
 Is your facility accessible?
 Our Tours & Rec Center is fully ADA-accessible. A ramp at the southwest corner of the building leads to the first floor; the second floor Beer Hall is accessible via elevator.
 Our brewery tours range across our expansive, multi-story campus and include more than 160 stair steps, but ramps or elevators allow access to all stops. Due to the ‘behind the scenes’ nature of some specialty tours, many stops are accessible only via stairs.
 Strollers are not permitted on tours, but may be left behind at our Tours & Rec Center.
 Do I need a reservation for the Beer Hall?
 No, reservations are not necessary. However, for parties of 20 or more please email  reservations@boulevard.com  to plan ahead and explore group options. If you'd like to book a private event, visit our event spaces page for more information. 
 Do I have to take a tour to visit the Beer Hall?
 Nope. Any and all are welcome, before a tour, after a tour, or if you want to hang in a cool space with fun people, delicious beer, beverages and good food. All-ages are also welcome. 
 When is the Rec Deck open?
 The Rec Deck is currently open only for special events and private parties. For more information about renting the Rec Deck, visit our Rental Spaces page.
 On busy weekends, check out our first floor Tasting Room, featuring a pub-like atmosphere with newly added games & TVs (shuffleboard, anyone?)!
 Can I bring my dog?
 We’re dog lovers as well, but the Tours & Rec Center and Beer Hall can only welcome registered service animals due to KCMO Health Department Regulations.  During certain seasons our Parklet is open and allows pups, but it's best give us a call first before heading out – 816-701-7247
 Can I bring my own food?
 While we love all the amazing restaurants and food that surround our brewery –  due to KCMO health codes you may not bring in outside food to the Beer Hall or Tours Tasting Room during public hours. Our Beer Hall does have a kitchen with plenty of delicious items that pair perfectly with our beer & bevs.

Questions
 Is your facility accessible?
 Our Tours & Rec Center is fully ADA-accessible. A ramp at the southwest corner of the building leads to the first floor; the second floor Beer Hall is accessible via elevator.
 Our brewery tours range across our expansive, multi-story campus and include more than 160 stair steps, but ramps or elevators allow access to all stops. Due to the ‘behind the scenes’ nature of some specialty tours, many stops are accessible only via stairs.
 Strollers are not permitted on tours, but may be left behind at our Tours & Rec Center.
 Can I reserve tickets in advance or over the phone?
 Tickets to our tours are reserved online. Advance ticket sales stop at 10:00 am CST on the day of the tour. Occasionally day-of tickets will be available if all tickets are not sold by door opening; so you may inquire at the front desk. However, please note that weekend and holiday time slots typically fill up fast!
 Do I need to bring anything with me?
 Anyone planning to sample should be prepared to present a valid ID. Brewery Tour guests are strongly encouraged to wear closed-toe shoes. Specialty Tour guests must wear closed-toe shoes (anyone not wearing closed-toe shoes for a ‘behind the scenes’ tour will not be permitted to take the tour and will forfeit their ticket cost).
 Who can take a tour?
 Our Brewery Tours are open to visitors of all ages but are not recommended for children under the age of seven. Remember, it’s a working manufacturing plant; all little ones must be kept close.
Specialty Tours are limited to those 21 and over; attendees must present a valid ID.
Please be considerate of your fellow travelers – visitors behaving badly will be asked to leave.
 I’m running 5 minutes late for my tour, I am so sorry! Can I be caught up?
 Due to the expansiveness of our campus and safety standards, we cannot catch any guest up to a tour that has left the Tours & Rec Center—no exceptions.
 I booked a private tour for 15 guests, but only have 10! Can we have extra beers to make up for this?
 Private Tours are charged a flat rate regardless of guest count, and the amount of beer included is allocated by each guest in attendance only.

 An Irish Pub & Restaurant: Local Pub. Irish Soul
 The Shannon Rose Irish Pub is a family owned & operated concept that blends authentic Irish roots with a strong commitment to the local community. With locations in Clifton and Ramsey, NJ, each pub features décor and furnishings imported directly from Ireland, creating a genuine Irish pub experience. The chef-driven menu combines traditional Irish favorites with modern tavern classics, featuring scratchmade dishes crafted with seasonal and locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
 Behind the bar, guests can enjoy more than 40 whiskeys, bourbons, and scotches, over 30 beers on tap, and a perfectly poured pint of Guinness. From live entertainment and whiskey tastings to beer dinners and special events, there's always something happening at The Shannon Rose. Dedicated to warm hospitality and memorable experiences, The Shannon Rose welcomes every guest like family.

 About Us
 Inca Paisa began from a memory of home. A childhood filled with family meals, vibrant flavors, and a culture where food brought people together. When life led from Colombia to New York, that memory stayed alive, and the idea of creating a place that honored it slowly took shape. 
 The dream was simple. Build a space where the spirit of Peru and Colombia could live in harmony. Two cultures connected through history, ingredients, and a love for food that carries identity and story in every bite. Inca Paisa was created to celebrate that connection and share it with anyone who walks through the door. 
 Every detail reflects that intention. The recipes, the atmosphere, the ingredients, and the warmth are all chosen with care. At the table, strangers become guests, and guests become part of the story. Meals become moments worth remembering. 
 At its heart, our restaurant is a tribute to heritage, love, and tradition. A reminder that food can hold memories and create new ones at the same time. 
 What We Believe
 Sharing the flavors and traditions of Peru and Colombia with food that comes from the heart.
 What We Aim For
 Creating a warm and welcoming space where every meal feels meaningful and memorable.

Reach out, and we will respond with the attention, care, and hospitality that define who we are.  our story 
 Humble Beginnings
 In 1970, 35-year-old Umberto Ianniello strolled around New York City's Little Italy and realized there were only a couple of seafood restaurants in the entire neighborhood. Named after the last Prince of Italy, Umberto kept the idea to himself until he spoke to his parents about his idea of opening a restaurant! His parents encouraged Umberto to realize his dream, and in 1972, Umberto Ianniello opened his first restaurant, Umberto's Clam House on Mulberry Street in New York City.
 With an unpretentious atmosphere and an enduring concern for freshness, Umberto worked tirelessly to achieve unprecedented quality and uniqueness at his restaurant. This came to fruition in their open kitchen (which became part of Umbertos alluring ambiance) and helped make Umbertos Clam House an overnight success!

 the hearth of ''Little Italy''
 KEEPING TRADITION THROUGH THE GENERATIONS
 In 2005, Mr. Ianniello passed his legacy to his son Robert Ianiello Jr. who has been working hard to protect the famous eatery. Robert Jr. says, ''My father started Umbertos in the early 70's and helped revitalize and reinvent Little Italy. Umbertos Clam House quickly became a haven for people to enjoy great food while absorbing provocative NYC atmosphere. I'm proud to carry on my family's tradition of flavorful innovative Italian style cooking with a modern flair.
 A VIBRANT PRESENT
 Today Umberto's is a destination for locals, tourists, and celebrities alike. Our new menu features our legendary Hot Red Clam Sauce which is simmered to perfection for hours just as it was in 1972. Umbertos also offers many new exciting dishes such as: Short Rib Ragu Over Penne, Spiedini a la Romano and more.
 Actors, sports figures, politicans, musicians and celebrities all flock to Umbertos! From acting legends Robert DeNiro and Michael Douglas to David Chase, creator of the hit TV series The Sopranos to its' stars, James Gandolfini and Edie Falco, Umbertos is truly a New York City Legend!
 Umbertos is a special treat for all who come. Our signature open kitchen has been remodeled and most recently we've added a custom built wood bar. So come in and enjoy NYC 's best.
 Our unpretentious flair and professional service combined with the freshest most authentic product possible...all at reasonable prices... keep our customers satisfied and coming back for more.

 ABOUT US 
 The Bully 
 Nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of Forest Hills, Queens Bully pays homage to its surroundings with a name inspired by the iconic Queens Boulevard. As a gastropub, we provide a welcoming and expansive space where patrons can indulge in a delectable fusion of American BBQ, globally-inspired dishes, and an array of carefully crafted cocktails and beers. Since our establishment in July 2017, Queens Bully has become synonymous with the cultural tapestry that defines Queens, earning a cherished place in the hearts of locals as their go-to gastropub. Our unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional culinary experiences and beverages is a source of great pride.
 A WORD FORM THE FOUNDERS 
 Dear Queens Bully Community,
 As the founders of Queens Bully, we wanted to take a moment to reflect on our incredible journey since our inception in 2017. It has been a wild ride, filled with delicious flavors, diverse experiences, and a whole lot of passion!
 Our mission at Queens Bully is simple: to bring the world's tastes to our beloved borough while creating an inclusive and joyful environment for our patrons and family. We are proud to be an integral part of the Queens Gastronome community, pushing boundaries and making waves in the F&B scene.
 One of our biggest achievements has been the recognition we've received from esteemed publications like Infatuation, Eater, Thrillist, and many more. Being hailed as trailblazers of the Queens Gastronome Community is truly an honor, and we couldn't have done it without the incredible support from our loyal patrons and the hard work of our dedicated team.
 Speaking of our team, we consider ourselves one big family. Our diverse and talented staff brings a wealth of expertise and cultural experiences to the table, making Queens Bully a true melting pot of flavors and ideas. We are constantly striving to provide a safe and wholesome environment for our team members to thrive and grow.
 But our pride doesn't stop at our culinary creations and team. We take immense joy in collaborating with local business owners, organizing networking social events, and building partnerships within our vibrant community. Queens is not just a place where we operate our business; it's our home, and we are dedicated to supporting its growth and evolution.
 Of course, our proudest accomplishment to date has been our collaboration with World Central Kitchen (WCK) during the challenging times of the COVID-19 pandemic. Through our kitchen and the logistical support of WCK, we were able to prepare and serve over 100,000 meals to those in need. It was an extraordinary effort that showcased the power of community and compassion.
 Looking ahead, we remain committed to sustainability. We understand the importance of preserving our planet and ensuring a brighter future. That's why we have partnered with environmentally conscious brands like Uber Eats and invested in sustainable branded packaging. We are determined to reduce waste, minimize our carbon footprint, and pave the way for a more eco-friendly future.
 As we continue on this incredible journey, we invite you to join us in celebrating the flavors, cultures, and spirit of Queens. Queens Bully is more than just a restaurant; it is a testament to the resilience and diversity of this remarkable borough. Together, let's keep pushing boundaries, supporting our community, and savoring the remarkable flavors that make Queens Bully a culinary gem.
 With heartfelt gratitude,
Ro & Su
 The Community 
 At Queens Bully, community connection and support are at the heart of everything we do. As a community-based, Queens-first establishment, we are dedicated to making a positive impact through various initiatives.
 During the challenging times of the COVID-19 pandemic, we partnered with World Central Kitchen (WCK) to serve our community. Utilizing our kitchen, we prepared over 100,000 meals for individuals and families in need, supporting WCK's heroic efforts to feed frontline workers and those facing hardships.
 We also joined forces with local businesses for a food drive during 718 Day, providing meals to over 200 residents of Queens. Collaborating with others in the community allows us to amplify our impact and uplift those in need.
 Breast Cancer Awareness holds a special place in our hearts. Each October, we develop merchandise to raise awareness and dedicate the profits to the American Cancer Society. By combining our love for food with a commitment to a vital cause, we contribute to research and support programs.
 Global solidarity is important to us. When India faced the COVID-19 crisis, we collected proceeds from our Indian-inspired cocktails and donated to relief efforts. Our support extended beyond our immediate surroundings, demonstrating our belief in the power of global unity.
 Locally, we collaborate with New York Relief to provide food assistance to communities in need. Partnering with organizations like New York Relief allows us to reach those who require assistance and make a meaningful difference in their lives.
 At Queens Bully, we strive to be more than just a restaurant. Our dedication to community connection and support is unwavering. By actively engaging in initiatives that improve lives, uplift essential workers, and contribute to vital causes, we create a positive impact.
 Join us in building a thriving community where everyone feels seen, heard, and nourished. Together, we can create a brighter future for all.

 AquaMarina is an intimate neighborhood restaurant & bar, offering authentic & flavorful Italian cuisine, with a large variety of seafood options, in the heart of Washington Heights 
 ORDER NOW 
 Aqua Marina is a gem in Washington Heights…
a little bit of authentic Italy, uptown.
 Soon to celebrate its 15th remarkable year, the restaurant recently expanded and underwent a complete renovation. The mainstay of the restaurant — the delicious Italian cuisine — is overseen by owner Omara Reyes, who turned her passion for food into a hit cooking show on a local NYC cable station.
 From Angel Hair Pomodoro and Penne Melanzana to Veal Saltimbocca and Chicken Montebianco, Aqua Marina runs the gamut of enticing regional Italian food served in a relaxing ambiance by an attentive staff.
 Dominican-born Reyes spices up the menu by offering her loyal customers Spanish dishes as well, including the ever-popular Churrasco. The variety of seafood offerings is a welcome change to the usual fare at most Italian restaurants.
 Aqua Marina boasts daily lunch specials as well as an Early Bird reduced priced menu.
 Aqua Marina has culled a large, loyal clientele over the years for great food served at popular prices.

 Hello Hello is a hi-dive bar and cafe in Chelsea where elevated cocktails meet the ease of a classic dive. By day, we’re a neighborhood cafe serving coffee, light bites, and cocktails from morning to last call. By night, we transition into a listening bar, pairing distinctive cocktails with a robust DJ lineup. 
 SEE OUR MENUS 
 11TH HOUR COFFEE LIQUEUR 
 All-Day Café & Coffee
 Step into a modern take on a ’70s lounge, with warm wood tones, elevated café seating, and an atmosphere made for casual work sessions and midday resets. Enjoy artisanal lattes, locally sourced pastries, and as many fresh espressos as you need.
 CAFE MENU 
 Bar Bites & Small Plates
 Our food menu features bold takes on elevated bar fare, from snacks and dips to empanadas and house-rubbed wings. A hot dog lineup celebrates the city’s street food classic, with all-beef and vegan options and unique toppings.
 BAR BITES MENU

 At night, Hello Hello transforms into a cocktail destination for industry insiders and locals alike.  11th Hour Coffee Liqueur

The first release, 11th Hour coffee liqueur, is made using only coffee, water, alcohol, and sugar, reflecting the depth and intensity of New York coffee. 
 Made in New York. Made clean. Made for the moment.
 11TH HOUR COFFEE LIQUEUR 
 Nightly DJ & Events
 Hello Hello is a listening bar built for sound, equipped with a full DJ setup for vinyl and CDJ use. Our nightly programming features some of New York's best DJs, with each evening centered around a specific music genre.

 About Us
 Our Story
 Hello Hello was founded by industry veterans Luis Hernandez, Brendan Bartley, and Robert Nieves, whose experience spans some of New York’s most iconic venues. Their vision was simple: to create the kind of place they genuinely wanted to spend time in. 
 Set within a unique ’70s-inspired space designed by West Chin Architects, Hello Hello is a neighborhood destination for excellent drinks, old-school hospitality, and just the right amount of shenanigans.
 By day, we serve coffee, pastries, and cocktails from morning until last call. Our bar program reimagines classic cocktails through a unique lens, complemented by comfort bites and a signature hot dog lineup. A nightly DJ lineup sets the tone, carrying the energy through the evening. 
 In the back of the space is Silent Alibi Distillery, Manhattan’s first distillery since Prohibition and home to 11th Hour Coffee Liqueur . Here, ideas are developed and brought to life, allowing for a true still-to-bar experience.
 Whether it’s the first hello of the morning with your coffee, or the last hello of the evening with your favorite cocktail, there’s always a seat waiting for you. 
 Meet The Team
 Brendan Bartley
 FORMULATOR & DISTILLER
 Brendan Bartley is an award-winning beverage director, distiller, and consultant with over 15 years of industry experience. Known for his technical precision and creative range, Brendan has built a career at the intersection of classic craftsmanship and modern formulation.
 Brendan holds a degree in viticulture and oenology from the University of Adelaide and a WSET Level 2 certification in wines and spirits from TAFE Adelaide. His training includes rum formulation under Master Blender Alexandre Gabriel and an apprenticeship at Hippocampus Distillery. Brendan is the winner of the La Maison Cointreau Cocktail Competition in Australia and has contributed to the formulation of Hefeweizen Whiskey.
 Brendan currently serves as Beverage Director at Bathtub Gin and is co-owner of Bonne Vie Armagnac. As the creator of Revivalist’s Garden Gin, he earned double gold at both the San Francisco and New York World Spirits Awards in 2021. His latest creation is 11th Hour Coffee Liqueur, developed at Silent Alibi Distillery with a focus on clean ingredients, balance, and versatility. 
 Luis Hernandez
 HELLO HELLO FOOD & BEVERAGE DIRECTOR
 Luis Hernandez is the Food & Beverage Director at Hello Hello and a New York City bartender known for his creative approach and deep industry experience. He also serves as Brand Manager and Sales Director for Ume Plum Liqueur.
 Previously, Luis was Bar Manager at Seamstress NYC, which was named to Esquire’s Top 100 Bars in America. He’s a New York winner of Bombay Sapphire’s Most Imaginative Bartender and Bacardi Legacy, and the national winner of Pau Maui Vodka’s Road to Maui competition.
 A natural educator and speaker, Luis has shared his perspective at Tales of the Cocktail, Bar Institute, Portland Cocktail Week, and the Culinary Institute of America. His work has been featured in GQ , The Wall Street Journal , Wine Enthusiast , Fox & Friends , and more.
 Robert Nieves
 11TH HOUR HEAD OF SALES
 Robert Nieves is a respected New York City bartender and spirits educator with a career spanning brand building, education, and on-premise growth.
 In addition to being a partner at Hello Hello and Head of Sales at Silent Alibi Distillery, he currently serves as a Sales Manager for Ten To One Rum, one of the most awarded rum producers in the country.
 At Ten To One, Robert has led key product launches and high-impact collaborations, driving market growth through strategic account development and creative initiatives, including the Ten To One Daiquiri Competition.
 From 2018 to 2021, Robert served as National Ambassador for the Facundo Rum Collection, Bacardi’s private family reserve, as well as Bacardi’s Incubation Brand Portfolio and Single Malt Portfolio. Robert continues to bridge hospitality, education, and spirits innovation across both brand and on-premise worlds. 
 Dave Oz
 BUSINESS MANAGER
 Dave Oz is a Brooklyn-born entrepreneur and the founder of Bathtub Gin, one of New York City’s top-grossing, high-volume bars and a true industry institution, recognized with numerous national accolades.
 Before entering hospitality, Dave spent a decade as a CPA at Arthur Andersen and Ernst & Young. In 2011, he left a successful finance career to pursue his passion, investing his life savings to launch Bathtub Gin. Through a distinctive concept, disciplined execution, and relentless attention to operations, he built it into one of the city’s most celebrated bars.
 Since then, Dave has developed additional standout hospitality concepts, including Two Forks and The 18th Room. Today, he brings his extensive operational expertise to Hello Hello and Silent Alibi Distillery, where he serves as a Business Manager.

 FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

 What kind of place is Hello Hello? 
 Hello Hello is a café by day and a cocktail bar by night, anchored by an on-site distillery. Guests come for coffee, food, cocktails, live DJ's, and hi-dive atmosphere, no matter the time of day. 
 Do you serve coffee and food during the day? 
 Yes. Mornings and afternoons feature café seating with specialty coffee, pastries, and a full food menu. 
 Is there really a distillery on site? 
 Yes. Silent Alibi Distillery is located at the back of the space, where small-batch spirits and 11th Hour Coffee Liqueur are produced. 
 Curious? Inquire about a tour! 
 Is Hello Hello 21+? 
 Yes. Guests must be 21+ after designated evening hours.
